name: Patient Intake and Scheduling Agent
headline: Make every visit-readiness handoff clear before staff take action
summary: Give patient-access teams a safe, read-only view of synthetic intake completeness, recorded coverage evidence, candidate availability, and pre-visit follow-up—without booking care or changing a record.
capabilities: Verify insurance, referrals, and network status during patient intake
Deliver tailored digital packets with all required pre‑visit forms
Automate reminders across multiple scheduled touchpoints
Ensure clinicians’ availability and readiness through up‑to‑date scheduling data
value: Improves consistency when staff review intake completeness and unresolved evidence.
Clarifies coverage and availability follow-up without implying eligibility or booking.
Reduces avoidable handoff ambiguity while preserving human approval and minimum-necessary privacy controls.

notice.text: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
